item.title: How to backup Airbyte on Google Cloud Storage?
item.description: I found on the airbyte forum how to backup the Airbyte instance to a new instance but I also used this resource to create a backup script of Airbyte.

item.title: How to host Airbyte on Google Cloud Platform?
item.description: In this article I’ll show you how to setup Airbyte on Google Cloud Platform.

item.title: What is Boyer-Moore majority vote algorithm?
item.description: Boyer–Moore majority vote algorithm The Boyer-Moore voting algorithm is a clever method to find the majority element in an array (an element that appears more than n/2 times) using O(1) space and O(n) time.

item.title: Caviar-airways: discover the world through music
item.description: Explore Caviar-airways, a unique website blending music and travel. Discover Spotify playlists pinned on an interactive map, built with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JS. Learn about the project's origin and development.

item.title: Building a Local Data Platform with Terraform and Docker
item.description: A step-by-step guide to building a fully local, cloud-like data platform using Terraform, Docker, Airflow, and more.

item.title: GDPR for Data Engineers: A Practical Guide to Privacy-Compliant Data Architecture
item.description: A hands-on guide to GDPR for data engineers: pseudonymization, erasure workflows, architecture patterns, and real-world code examples.

item.title: Mastering Apache Spark for Data Engineering Interviews: Concepts, Code, and Real Questions
item.description: A comprehensive guide to mastering Apache Spark for Data Engineering interviews with practical examples and performance optimization tips.

item.title: Building Reliable Data Pipelines: A Complete Guide to dbt Contracts and Schema Enforcement
item.description: Learn how to implement robust data contracts in dbt using schema enforcement. This comprehensive guide covers contract types, implementation strategies, and real-world examples to ensure data reliability and prevent pipeline failures.

item.title: Getting Started with dbt-core: A Beginner’s Guide to Data Transformation
item.description: Learn dbt-core from scratch. This beginner-friendly tutorial shows you how to set up dbt, connect to a warehouse, and run your first SQL models with Jinja templates.

item.title: Understanding the Difference Between Sources and Models in dbt-core
item.description: Clarify the fundamental difference between sources and models in dbt-core. Learn how they function in the analytics engineering workflow, how to define them, and best practices for building robust data transformation pipelines.
